description: EXPR-BIND, deciding variants: parameter change, held recordset and SQL replacement, with no Requery. Saved QBp (PARAMETERS pl Long; SELECT pl + 1 AS v FROM One) is opened with pl = 1 (rs1 kept open), pl set to 2 and opened again (rs2), rs1 moved to its first row and read again, then QBp.SQL is replaced by a text adding 10, QBp is opened again (rs3) and rs1 and rs2 are read again. Follow-up probe (status F) for EXPR-BIND; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
